244	The transition type is not automatic. You decide which links are "forward" and which are "back" based on your app's navigation hierarchy.
245	
246	Then wrap page content in a `ViewTransition` that maps transition types to directional animations:
247	
248	```tsx filename="app/photo/[id]/page.tsx"
249	<ViewTransition
250	  enter={{
251	    'nav-forward': 'nav-forward',
252	    'nav-back': 'nav-back',
253	    default: 'none',
254	  }}
255	  exit={{
256	    'nav-forward': 'nav-forward',
257	    'nav-back': 'nav-back',
258	    default: 'none',
259	  }}
260	  default="none"
261	>
262	  {/* page content */}
263	</ViewTransition>
264	```
